title: chrysanthemum cinereum
intro: Chrysanthemum cinereum, commonly known as the silver-flowered chrysanthemum, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and relieving respiratory issues due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Chrysanthemum cinereum include its use as a diuretic to treat urinary issues and as a expectorant to help relieve coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
